open_points.subject: State 5 refusal semantics for internal errors
open_points.text: "internal_error | nothing was changed; no detail" and "When a request makes several store changes, those made before the failed one stay"
open_points.question: When an MCP operation returns `internal_error`, must callers assume no state change, or can earlier store changes in the same request already be committed?
options: `internal_error` may be returned after partial request progress (earlier successful store changes remain)
open_points.default_guess: Treat `internal_error` as possibly after partial progress, because the Conventions section explicitly allows earlier committed store changes to remain.

open_points.subject: functions.read_slot output contract for stale-serving implementation
open_points.text: "A serving implementation without a verdict over the current corpus is shown so (A04 rule 7)."
open_points.question: Exactly how does `functions.read_slot` encode that an implementation is currently serving but lacks a verdict over the current corpus?
options: Explicit boolean/field on the implementation entry
Implicitly by absence of a verdict group for the current corpus digest
Separate warning object at slot/contract-version level
open_points.default_guess: Infer it from absence of a verdict for the current corpus digest while that implementation is current activation.

open_points.subject: store.read_records relation: trial executions over a corpus digest
open_points.text: "trial executions of an implementation over a corpus digest ... the latest TrialExecution M07 per case of that corpus"
open_points.question: How are TrialExecutions selected "over a corpus digest" when M07 has no corpus-digest field and executions may come from try calls and interrupted admissions?
options: Only executions referenced by an AdmissionVerdict for that corpus digest
All executions made while that digest was current, using store-order windows
Latest execution per case regardless of source, filtered only by implementation and cases in the corpus
open_points.default_guess: Use executions referenced by the AdmissionVerdict for that corpus digest; if no such verdict exists, return none.
